This album will contain a bunch of images/mini comics that I've translated. I've been wanting to share these, but they are all either too small, or not worth putting into their own album, so I decided to put them all into this album. It will mainly be scat stuff with some occasional peeing/omorashi stuff thrown in. I will update this album whenever I find more images that I like and want to translate them. I know this is a rather niche fetish, but maybe you might find something you like in this album. You never know. You can also commission stuff for this album, or other comics you want done. (Read below for more details)
